title: My dog does not bark for bark boxes.
text:
I contacted you over two months ago to cancel my subscription...but now still getting them. In December I received a double deluxe.
Lacey , My Maltipoo...does not like any of the treats or bones, plus too big. I gave them to the neighbor. Can I send it back, not opened...and please credit my account? The toys are cheap too. Sorry. But “BARK BOX” is not for us. Please respond.
Kim Busby. 1/4/2020
label: negative
